parties: Collin Pulle Victor Pulle and Others v. K.M. Podihamine Collin Pulle Victor Pulle and Others v. K.M. Podihamine View More
keywords: Post-judgment partition dispute where defendants sought re-allotment of shares from the interlocutory decree. District Court rejected all applications, finding claimants failed to establish their rights to the unallotted shares by evidence. Court of Appeal upheld the District Court, further noting that the proper remedy was an interlocutory appeal, not the current application. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
